title: Homogeneity of the Lévy collapse from the perspective of Fraïssé theory
summary: Given a strongly inaccessible cardinal $λ$, we study the Fraïssé class of all Boolean algebras of size $<λ$, together with regular embeddings. We prove that this is indeed a Fraïsséclass, and its limit has the same completion as the Lévy collapse. We also give a direct proof that the collapsing algebra of density $κ$ is not the union of a $κ$-chain of regular sub-algebras of density $<κ$.
